_notes: Scene Machine model allowlist. Ships in the single image; the backend loads it like actions.json; the UI can fetch it via GET /definitions/models.json.
Underscore keys are documentation: ignored by loader, validator, and tests.
defaults: the default model per family, used when a caller does not pick one.

actions: one entry per model-parameterized action in actions.json. location_param is the node parameter carrying the model location (null = no location param; the worker runs it at a hardcoded region). default_key is the config field the UI resolver reads its default from.

models: keyed by exact Vertex model ID. locations must cover every location the UI, config.template.txt, and workflow_examples submit. capabilities is a forward-looking catalog: the validator checks only model/action/location, so no capability field gates runtime yet (image_sizes is read only by a CI drift test). Values marked UNVERIFIED still need confirming against the model docs.

release_date / retirement_date (from the model-versions lifecycle table, YYYY-MM-DD). retirement_date is the earliest date the model may be retired ('Not before ...' in the table); null = no date announced, a short-term model, or not in the table.

gemini-3.5-flash._notes: Template default GEMINI_MODEL (config.template.txt:19), GEMINI_REGION=global. describe_image/analyse_file carry no location param (the worker runs them at a hardcoded region), so their (model, location) pair check is vacuous.

gemini-3.1-pro-preview._notes: Gemini 3.1 Pro (preview). Not in the GA lifecycle table -- preview models retire 45 days after their GA replacement. Callable in global only (absent in us-central1), verified 2026-07-06; capabilities UNVERIFIED.

gemini-3.1-flash-lite._notes: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite. Callable in global only (absent in us-central1), verified 2026-07-06; capabilities UNVERIFIED -- confirm against the model docs.

veo-3.1-generate-001._notes: Template default VEO_MODEL (config.template.txt:26), VEO_REGION=global. us-central1 required: workflow_examples submit gcp_location=us-central1. max_videos_per_request=4 and 720p/1080p durations 4/6/8s verified live in global 2026-07-06 (the '1080p 8s-only' claim was disproven). 4k submit accepted, but generation did not complete under load; 8s-only behavior unverified (Veo Lite by contrast cleanly rejects 4k: 'Unsupported output video resolution RESOLUTION_4K'). enhance_prompt cannot be disabled on Veo 3.x (live operation error 2026-07-06). Capability fields are not yet enforced or wired in veo.py.

veo-3.1-fast-generate-001._notes: Used by workflow_examples (gcp_location=us-central1). Same capabilities as veo-3.1-generate-001. max_videos_per_request=4 and 720p/1080p durations 4/6/8s verified live 2026-07-06. 4k submit accepted, but generation did not complete under load; 8s-only behavior unverified. enhance_prompt cannot be disabled on Veo 3.x (live operation error 2026-07-06). Capability fields are not yet wired.

veo-3.1-lite-generate-001._notes: Veo 3.1 Lite. veo-3.1-lite-generate-001 verified callable in global + us-central1 2026-07-06 (batched 2->2, 4->4); the Gemini API names it veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview. 1080p accepts 4/6/8s (verified live). No 4k -- cleanly rejected: 'Unsupported output video resolution RESOLUTION_4K'. No reference_images (Lite excludes them). Launch stage Preview, release 2026-04-02 (Vertex model page). enhance_prompt cannot be disabled on Veo 3.x (verified live 2026-07-06).

gemini-3-pro-image._notes: Nano Banana Pro; template default IMAGE_MODEL (config.template.txt:33), IMAGE_MODEL_REGION=global. Outpaint-eligible: {2K,4K} subset of image_sizes (the outpainter always requests 2K/4K). image_sizes {1K,2K,4K} and no video input -- verified against the model docs 2026-07-06.

gemini-3.1-flash-image._notes: Nano Banana 2 (non-Lite); recommended in the config.template.txt comment. Outpaint-eligible: {2K,4K} subset of image_sizes. image_sizes {0.5K,1K,2K,4K}, default 1K; generates from video input -- verified against the model docs 2026-07-06. Resolves in global only (absent in us-central1), verified 2026-07-06.

gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image._notes: Nano Banana 2 Lite (Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image). Short-term availability model (retires 45 days after a replacement ships), so no fixed retirement date. Resolves in global only (absent in us-central1), verified 2026-07-06. image_sizes {1K} only and generates from video input -- verified against the model docs 2026-07-06. generate_image only (outpaint needs 2K/4K, which this lacks).
